Bid Summary.value: The State of Maryland Treasurer's Office is procuring Dell Laptops w/Extended Warranty under Bid E20P4600040; BPM044557; 00004079359, specifically 30 Dell Latitude 5550 units and 30 Dell Thunderbolt 4 Dock – WD22TB4 units. The bid is due on 06/10/2024 at 02:00 PM EDT, and no addendum changing the deadline is provided; no pre-bid meeting is stated. Bids must be submitted through the State’s eMaryland Marketplace Advantage (eMMA) e-Procurement system, and bids will not be accepted by email, fax, U.S. Mail, or hand delivery. The procurement uses the Desktop, Laptop and Tablet 2015 Master Contract, 060B5400007, and the Master Contractor must be an authorized Dell reseller; the State may request a Letter of Authorization from the Manufacturer or Distributor. Delivery is required within 45 days of award to 80 Calvert Street, Room 109, Annapolis, MD 21401, and proposals/quotes must remain valid for at least 90 days after the due date; warranty details are limited to the extended warranty in the title, and no contract duration or renewal options are stated. Invoice(s) must be submitted within 10 days of delivering the equipment and emailed to STOaccountspayable@treasurer.state.md.us with the required supporting information, including proof of delivery and equipment serial numbers; buyer-to-vendor payment timing is not stated.
